[b]Chaos in the capital[/b]

[i]In the aftermath of the revolution in Flousechia which led to the end of the monarchy and the collapse of the bi-national state. Nevonia was on its own with the increasingly unpopular monarchy. Flousechia and Nevonia were officially one bi-national state but in reality Flousechia held most of the power and often influenced the local affairs of Nevonia. So as the revolution in Flousechia became more violent and as the Flousechian monarchy was overthrown, the union between the two states came crashing down. With the complete independence of Nevonia King Klaes II had complete control without any checks. As this all occured people were not at all happy. Anti-monarchy protest across the country sprung up. Out of fear of being overthrown the King made a technical concession. The government would have a change in leadership where a Prime Minister would be in charge instead of the King. However there was a technicality because the King would appoint the Prime Minister without any approval or conformation and the King could remove the Prime Minister at any time. As a result the Prime Minister became a pointless position and the people demanded true change.[/i]

[I]Protest throughout the country became bigger and in many cases protesters took over the streets. The protest though were largely peaceful. As protest grew so did the censorship. protesters were arrested and tortured, soldiers were stationed in cities to display fear and any form of media deemed to be anti-monarchy was outlawed. In the capital city of Tarenbur it seemed like there was a new protest 24/7. Outside of government buildings protest encampments were set up even when the encampments were destroyed protesters would keep building new ones. Every corner of the city was filled with protest and soon the police began to open fire. The King in his delusional view thought that he could fix everything so he went out on a balcony to speak to a crowd. As soon as King Klaes II opened his mouth hecklers yelled and interrupted the King before he could even speak, the speech was a disaster and helped nothing. It seemed the situation couldn't get worse but the worst was still to come.[/I]
